properties.name: Be'er Sheva, Omer and Lehavim
properties.description: A rectangle around Be'er Sheva, Omer and Lehavim, which also covers Tel Sheva, Laqiya and the edge of Rahat. The tile cut (just data), #168's clip and #209's service area share it. Changing it means re-running just data and committing the new israel_tiles_sha256.
